versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.13

- Updated documentation for improved clarity in SKILL.md, output format, and troubleshooting references.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to skill behavior or features.

Fix partial delivery of long summaries: on channels that cap message size (Telegram ~4096 chars), a 3-hour video's 9.4k-character summary silently lost everything past the first message. Summaries must now be split into consecutive numbered messages at chapter boundaries, with every part sent; part 1 alone counts as a failed delivery, and shortening or attaching a file is not an acceptable substitute.

Track youtube2md 1.2.0: short orienting Summary with detail in chapters, new --detail densities (750/450/300), 20k-token chunking, CHUNK_CHAPTER_CAP chapter granularity. Runner fixes: Codex availability now delegates to youtube2md's own detectCodexChatGptLogin (no more false-positive provider checks or silent OPENAI_API_KEY billing), YOUTUBE2MD_CAPTIONS_ONLY=1 is honored in full mode, and an unset YOUTUBE2MD_CAPTION_LANG now warns because YouTube's track order can return a translated transcript.
Full-mode output passed through verbatim; long summaries always delivered inline (never as a file attachment); frontmatter migrated to documented metadata.openclaw format
Pass full-mode youtube2md output through verbatim so summaries match running the package directly (no re-compression); scope compact template to simple/transcript modes
Update to youtube2md 1.1.0: add --detail (concise/balanced/exhaustive) summary detail density support

Add explicit secret-handling guidance for OPENAI_API_KEY and YouTube cookies in troubleshooting (ClawScan SQP-2). Same youtube2md v1.0.3 runtime as 1.0.6: Codex-first provider with OpenAI fallback, native timestamped-text extraction (no prepare.py), --caption-lang/--extract-format/--captions-only, Node 20.18.1+.

Update to youtube2md v1.0.3: Codex-first summarization provider with OpenAI API fallback, native timestamped-text transcript extraction (removes prepare.py/python dependency), --caption-lang / --extract-format / --captions-only support, versioned JSON envelope and expanded error codes, Node.js 20.18.1+ requirement.
Add bare YouTube URL summarization trigger and full/simple/transcript mode labels.
Update youtube2md to 1.0.2, set default model to gpt-5.4-mini, and refine summary prompts.
Remove bundled summaries outputs from published skill package; keep only source files (SKILL.md, scripts, references, prepare.py).
Add OPENAI_API_KEY env metadata; simplify runner hardening by removing deprecated runtime_npx override checks; update troubleshooting docs accordingly.
Lock youtube2md runtime to 1.0.1 and update security/runtime docs.

youtube-summary 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Summarizes YouTube videos using youtube2md, generating structured Markdown with chapters, timestamp links, and key takeaways.
- Supports both full (Markdown) and extract (transcript JSON/TXT) modes, with seamless fallback if API key is missing.
- Handles multiple video URLs and different output formats, including machine-readable JSON.
- Follows detailed workflow for input validation, runner selection, and user-friendly response formatting.
